timeline_template.description_en: Plough to fine tilth. Cowpea fixes nitrogen — modest base fertiliser only.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima vizuri. Kunde huleta nitrojeni — mbolea kidogo tu.
Panda moja kwa moja kina 3cm nafasi 30cm x 15cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 25kg DAP at planting. Light dose — beans are nitrogen-fixers.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 25 za DAP. Maharagwe huleta nitrojeni.
Palia juu juu. Epuka kusumbua mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for aphids; spray only if heavy infestation.
Pluck top tender leaves and shoots. Leave growing points intact.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chuna majani na shina laini ya juu. Acha kichwa cha mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Continue plucking every 7 days for 6 weeks. Grain harvest later if desired.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Tender leaves + shoots only. Reject tough or yellowed.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day. Sprinkle with water under shade.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; honeydew on leaves; check undersides of young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; utomvu majani; chunguza chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Weekly underside scouting, natural enemies first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery streaked leaves, distorted new growth, flower drop, in dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yenye michirizi ya fedha, ukuaji uliopinda, maua kuanguka.
diseases.treatment_en: Lambda-cyhalothrin-class at threshold; blue sticky traps for monitoring. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za lambda-cyhalothrin wakati wamezidi; mitego ya bluu kwa uchunguzi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Monitor during dry spells, preserve natural enemies.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza wakati wa kiangazi, hifadhi maadui wa asili.
diseases.scanner_notes: Silvery streaks distinguish thrips from virus mottling.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves in warm-dry spells.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting, cool morning hours. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza, asubuhi baridi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder on leaf surfaces; warm-dry weather.

diseases.symptoms_en: Water-soaked angular spots that brown and merge, leaf death in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa yaliyolowa yanageuka kahawia na kuungana, majani kufa mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Copper-class suppression only — no cure. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za copper kuzuia kuenea tu — hakuna tiba. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean certified seed, rotation, avoid working the crop when wet.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu safi, zungusha, epuka kufanya kazi unyevu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Angular water-soaked spots vs fungal rings.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Drought-tolerant leaf crop — pick every 2-3 weeks through the season. The dry-season leaf option.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Zao la majani linalostahimili ukame — vuna kila wiki 2-3. Chaguo la majani kiangazi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 20–40 KES per bunch retail (November 2026). Reliable when rains fail.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 20–40 kwa fungu (Novemba 2026). Huaminika mvua zinapokosekana.
